Before starting whitening treatment, a dental examination is important to identify the cause of discoloration. In some cases, professional cleaning may be recommended first to remove plaque and tartar deposits.

Why Saving Your Natural Tooth Is Often the Best Option | Dental Fit Super Speciality Dental Clinic

Many people assume that a severely damaged tooth should simply be removed. However, whenever possible, preserving a natural tooth is usually the preferred treatment approach.

In this case, a compromised tooth was successfully restored using:

• Root Canal Treatment (RCT)
• Post and Core Build-Up
• Full Coverage Metal Ceramic Crown

The root canal treatment removed the infection from inside the tooth, while the post and core helped rebuild and strengthen the remaining tooth structure. A metal ceramic crown was then placed to restore function, durability, and appearance.

Benefits of preserving a natural tooth:

• Maintains natural chewing ability
• Preserves surrounding bone structure
• Prevents neighboring teeth from shifting
• Helps maintain proper bite alignment
• Avoids the need for tooth replacement options

Modern restorative dentistry allows many teeth to be saved even when they appear severely damaged. Early intervention often increases the chances of successful treatment.

At Dental Fit Super Speciality Dental Clinic, Dr. Sumana Kar, MDS Prosthodontist and Implantologist, focuses on restoring and preserving natural teeth whenever clinically possible.

Because when a tooth can be saved, preserving it is often better than replacing it.

Teeth Cleaning vs Teeth Whitening: What's the Difference? | Dental Fit Super Speciality Dental Clinic

Many people want a brighter smile, but often confuse teeth cleaning with teeth whitening. While both treatments can improve the appearance of your teeth, they serve different purposes.

Teeth Cleaning is a preventive dental procedure that removes plaque, tartar, and surface stains from the teeth. It helps maintain healthy gums and reduces the risk of cavities and gum disease.

Teeth Whitening, on the other hand, is a cosmetic procedure designed to lighten the natural shade of your teeth and reduce discoloration.

Teeth Cleaning helps with:

• Plaque removal
• Tartar and calculus removal
• Fresher breath
• Healthier gums
• Prevention of dental problems

Teeth Whitening helps with:

• Yellow teeth
• Coffee and tea stains
• Tobacco-related discoloration
• Enhancing smile appearance
• Achieving a brighter tooth shade

A common misconception is that teeth cleaning will make teeth dramatically whiter. Cleaning removes deposits and stains, but it cannot change the natural color of your teeth. If you want a noticeably brighter smile, professional teeth whitening may be the better option.

In many cases, dentists recommend a professional cleaning before whitening treatment to achieve the best results.

Brushing Twice a Day But Still Have Yellow Teeth? | Dental Fit Super Speciality Dental Clinic Andheri East Mumbai

Many people brush their teeth twice a day and still wonder why their teeth look yellow. The truth is that yellow teeth are not always caused by poor oral hygiene.

One common reason is thinning of the enamel, the outer white layer of the tooth. As enamel becomes thinner, the naturally yellow dentin underneath becomes more visible.

Enamel can wear down due to:

• Natural aging
• Aggressive brushing habits
• Frequent consumption of acidic foods and drinks
• Genetic factors

Yellow teeth can also be caused by external stains from:

• Tea and coffee
• Tobacco products
• Certain foods and beverages

Other possible causes include:

• Excess fluoride exposure during tooth development
• Certain antibiotics taken during childhood
• Tartar and calculus buildup caused by inadequate professional cleaning

The first step toward a brighter smile is identifying the actual cause of the discoloration. Different causes require different treatment approaches, which may include professional cleaning, polishing, whitening procedures, or other dental treatments.
